title: Draganfly and TAF Industries Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Canada–Ukraine Defence Manufacturing Capabilities
body_markdown:
*Collaboration to explore Canadian manufacturing, technology integration and joint development of advanced Ukrainian unmanned systems*


**KYIV, Ukraine, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —** Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO; CSE: DPRO; FSE: 3U8) (“Draganfly” or the “Company”), a Canadian-headquartered developer of advanced drone solutions, unmanned systems and software, today announced a strategic cooperation agreement with TAF Industries, one of Ukraine’s leading defence technology companies, developing and manufacturing innovative solutions for modern warfare, establishing a framework to explore the development, manufacture and integration of Ukrainian unmanned systems technologies in Canada.


The collaboration will combine TAF Industries extensive operational experience, including the continuous adaptation of technologies based on feedback from more than 250 military units and the validation of these technologies under real-world battlefield conditions, with Draganfly’s Canadian engineering, manufacturing and systems-integration capabilities. Together, the companies will evaluate opportunities to establish Canadian production capabilities, advance joint technology development and support evolving defence requirements in Canada and Ukraine.


Under the framework, Draganfly and TAF Industries intend to identify unmanned aerial systems (UAS) and unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) technologies suitable for Canadian manufacturing, assess potential procurement opportunities and explore a roadmap toward longer-term industrial cooperation. The work would draw on lessons from Ukraine, including the importance of adapting designs to user feedback and evaluating performance under realistic operating conditions, while assessing selected technologies against Canadian requirements.


“Canada has an opportunity to apply lessons from Ukraine to the way we develop, manufacture and support unmanned systems,” said Cameron Chell, Chief Executive Officer of Draganfly. “Working with TAF Industries is intended to connect Ukrainian technology and operational experience with our engineering and manufacturing capabilities in Canada. Our focus is on applying that combination into the industrial capacity requirements of both countries.”


“This is the first time TAF Industries has expanded its partnerships beyond Europe, broadening the geographical reach of our international cooperation,” said Oleksandr Yakovenko, Founder of TAF Industries **.** “Canada has been one of Ukraine’s most consistent partners, and cooperation between our defence companies will enable closer technological integration and strengthen both countries’ readiness to address potential threats. By combining TAF Industries’ expertise in UAV development and manufacturing, direct feedback from military personnel on the use of drones on the battlefield, and Draganfly’s manufacturing and technological capabilities, we are building a partnership that will support both Ukrainian service members and the armed forces of our allies.”


The agreement outlines a phased approach to cooperation, identifying products and requirements, followed by regulatory and supply-chain assessments, establishment of joint research and development, and evaluation for Canadian manufacturing opportunities.


Areas of potential cooperation include product enhancement, payload integration, autonomy, communications systems and mission-specific adaptations. The companies also intend to assess manufacturing locations, production capacity, workforce requirements, quality assurance and supply-chain considerations associated with producing selected technologies in Canada.


The companies will explore how Canadian assembly, integration and supply-chain capabilities could support additional production of selected Ukrainian technologies and their adaptation to Canadian requirements.


The collaboration is consistent with the Canada–Ukraine Declaration for a 100-Year Partnership, which identifies joint production, research and technology cooperation as priorities for the bilateral defence-industrial relationship.


**About TAF Industries**


TAF Industries is one of Ukraine’s leading defence technology companies, developing and manufacturing advanced solutions that provide a decisive battlefield advantage while helping protect the lives of military personnel and civilians. Their product portfolio includes over 30 combat-proven solutions, including strike drones, interceptor drones, reconnaissance UAV, optic fiber FPV drones, unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), repeater drones, and AI-enabled technologies.

**About Draganfly**


Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO; CSE: DPRO; FSE: 3U8) is a Canadian-headquartered developer of advanced drone solutions, unmanned systems and software serving customers across North America and globally. With more than 27 years of experience in unmanned systems, Draganfly develops and delivers technologies spanning aerial platforms, autonomy, sensing, payload integration and mission-specific solutions for defence, public safety and commercial applications.


The Company combines engineering, manufacturing, software and systems-integration capabilities to support customers operating in complex and mission-critical environments. Draganfly is driven by a mission to provide innovative, reliable solutions that save time, money and lives.
